Beautiful tactile materials, crisp legible architectural edges, coherent rigid perspective and believable human-sized construction. Standing eye-level viewpoint, natural wide angle, complete readable room with foreground depth, finished environmental painting. Soft cool daylight balanced with small warm household light, calm cared-for lived-in atmosphere, no exaggerated palace scale. No people, readable words, UI, navigation arrows, hotspot outlines, return-button graphics, watermark, collage, modern objects, magical effects, banners with heraldic emblems or named-world symbols. Scene: the LORD'S PRIVATE DRESSING ROOM, an inner room reached from the upper-floor lord's bedroom. The entrance is BEHIND THE CAMERA and outside the frame. This room is a branch endpoint: NO visible onward doors, open passages, stairways, secret exits, balconies or additional rooms. Cupboard doors are visibly furniture, not floor-to-ceiling architectural doors. Do not invent other navigation destinations.
A generous but intimate one-storey dressing room, approximately 3.4m high, pale warm-gray limestone, dark oak ceiling beams and warm oak floorboards, consistent with the existing bedroom's finely crafted dark-oak four-poster furniture and muted wine-red textiles. Along the LEFT wall, beautifully fitted full-height OAK WARDROBE FURNITURE with panelled fronts; a couple of cabinet sections stand open to reveal neatly hung plain wool cloaks, linen shirts and folded cloth in restrained natural colors, with no uniforms, badges or heraldic motifs. Make these cabinets unambiguously storage with shelves, rails and plinths, NOT doors into another room. A simple cushioned changing bench sits CENTER LEFT, angled and set to keep generous central floor space. A low chest of shallow drawers, a small dressing table with a plain comb, brush, folded gloves and an unmarked closed wooden box, and a leaded window with a stone sill on the RIGHT complete the practical space. Cool window daylight makes folds and woodwork readable, restrained warm wall candle reflections, quiet personal luxury without palace excess.
